observations: Photo 0 shows multiple solar panels stacked upright, leaning against a wall or fence.
The panels have a white frame and black monocrystalline cells with a diamond-shaped pattern at the junctions.
The cells are arranged in a grid, typical of standard solar panels.
There is a watermark 'ANYI BLESS SOLAR' overlaid on the image.
No visible brand name, model number, or rating label is readable on the panels in the photo.
The panels appear to be new or lightly used, with no obvious damage or discoloration.

claims.evidence: The power rating and type (mono) are not visible on the panel in photo 0. The seller's text claims it, but there is no visual proof.

risks.risk: The panels may not be 200W as claimed; they could be lower wattage or counterfeit.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the label on the back or frame of one panel showing the rated power, model, and manufacturer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower wattage or non-functional

risks.risk: The panels may be damaged or defective, such as microcracks in the cells or poor soldering, not visible in this photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cell surface under good lighting, showing no cracks or discoloration.

risks.risk: The panels may not be monocrystalline; they could be polycrystalline, which affects efficiency and price.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cell texture and color; monocrystalline cells are typically uniform black with rounded edges, while polycrystalline have a speckled blue appearance.
risks.if_unproven: priced as polycrystalline or unknown type

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the label on the back of one panel showing the model, wattage, and manufacturer.
Close-up photo of the cell surface to verify monocrystalline structure and check for cracks.
Photo of the panel's junction box and wiring to verify condition and quality.
response.reason: The seller claims a 200W monocrystalline panel, but no branding, model, or rating label is visible in the photo. Without proof of wattage, type, and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of misrepresentation or defect are high.
